newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha sags because of poor prompt demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha sags because of poor prompt demand.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices fell back and dealers said weakness in gasoline prices was putting pressure on prompt naphtha prices.
Dealers said July swaps were talked at around $174/$175 a tonne for most of the afternoon, with August in a contango of around a dollar to July.
The contango was widening because of a lack of demand in the prompt period, particularly for n+a material which is still unattractive when compared to gasoline.
Discussion on the physical markets was limited but dealers said there was still some interest for pipeline qualities for arrival in NWE in a week or two.
